question: Where was the 6th summit of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) held on 4 April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bangkok__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 6th summit of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) was held in **Bangkok, Bangladesh**, on **4 April 2025**.
 
• BIMSTEC is a regional organization comprising seven member states around the Bay of Bengal region—Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Thailand.
 
• The 6th BIMSTEC summit focused on enhancing regional connectivity, trade, and cooperation in critical sectors such as energy, technology, and disaster management.
 
• Bangladesh, being a founding member of BIMSTEC, has played a pivotal role in fostering regional integration and promoting economic cooperation among member countries.
 
• The summit served as a platform for member nations to discuss and adopt measures for strengthening ties and addressing shared challenges in the Bay of Bengal region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC):**

 
 
• BIMSTEC was established in **1997** through the Bangkok Declaration.
 
• The organization focuses on 14 priority sectors, including trade, energy, tourism, environment, and climate change.
 
• BIMSTEC serves as a bridge between South Asia and Southeast Asia, promoting economic and technical cooperation among member nations.
 
• The BIMSTEC Secretariat is headquartered in **Dhaka, Bangladesh**.
